chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked:
about: “the white thread from the black thread of dawn”
So he said: “It is the whiteness of the day from the darkness of the night.”

key_terms.الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ: the visible whiteness that appears at dawn
key_terms.الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ: the darkness of the night before dawn breaks
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: dawn, the break of day marking the start of fajr
key_terms.بَيَاضُ النَّهَارِ: the light and whiteness of daytime appearing
key_terms.سَوَادِ اللَّيْلِ: the darkness and blackness of the night

ai.seo_question: What does the white thread and black thread in the verse about dawn mean?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains the Qur'anic expression as referring to the visible emergence of daylight from the darkness of night. The narration clarifies the sign by which the beginning of fajr is recognized in relation to fasting and salat.
